text: Four Seasons Vilamoura is an independent apartment resort in the middle of Vilamoura, with views over the [Pinhal](/courses/vilamoura-pinhal) course, whose clubhouse is about **5 minutes** away by car. The [Old Course](/courses/vilamoura-old-course) is about 8 minutes away, [Vila Sol](/courses/vila-sol) about 9, and [Laguna](/courses/vilamoura-laguna) and [Millennium](/courses/vilamoura-millennium) about 10. It isn't part of the Four Seasons hotel brand. **Last checked: November 2026.**

text: The nearest courses at a glance
Slope ratings are from the Portuguese Golf Federation for the back tees: the higher the number, the harder the course for an average golfer.
**[Vilamoura Pinhal](/courses/vilamoura-pinhal)** (par 72, 6,353 m, slope 140): Frank Pennink's 1976 course through the pines, the toughest Vilamoura course on slope.

**[Vilamoura Old Course](/courses/vilamoura-old-course)** (par 73, 6,254 m, slope 136): Pennink's 1969 original and Vilamoura's most famous course, lined with umbrella pines, and its most expensive round.
**[Vila Sol](/courses/vila-sol)** (27 holes, slope 135 to 137): Donald Steel's Pestana course just outside Vilamoura, with three nines played in pairs and a €60 twilight rate from 3.30pm.

**[Vilamoura Laguna](/courses/vilamoura-laguna)** (par 72, 6,121 m, slope 135): flatter and more open than the pine-lined courses, with plenty of water. Vilamoura Golf has a free shared buggy offer on Laguna for new bookings made by 31 December 2026.

**[Vilamoura Millennium](/courses/vilamoura-millennium)** (par 72, 6,176 m, slope 130): Martin Hawtree's flat course with wide fairways, the easiest Vilamoura course on slope. Laguna and Millennium share the lowest green fees in Vilamoura, from €88.

**[Vale do Lobo Royal](/courses/vale-do-lobo-royal)** (par 72, 6,005 m, slope 133): home of the famous clifftop par-3 16th. Vale do Lobo's Sunset rate, from €76 in winter, includes a shared buggy for full-paying adults.
**[Vale do Lobo Ocean](/courses/vale-do-lobo-ocean)** (par 73, 6,122 m, slope 140): Sir Henry Cotton's original 1968 course, hillier than the Royal.

**[Pine Cliffs](/courses/pine-cliffs)** (9 holes, par 32, 2,227 m): Martin Hawtree's clifftop course at Olhos de Água, famous for its 6th, the Devil's Parlour. No handicap needed: players without one tee off from the red markers.
Golf at Four Seasons Vilamoura

The resort's website describes golf-course views and says you can step onto the Pinhal course from the resort. It has a **golf co-ordinator who arranges tee times, club hire and buggies**, and a golf academy with a PGA professional, Peter Lester.

Its golf breaks are sold through its own golf website, and the resort lists the savings against booking separately: from €88 to €151 in a studio, €96 to €193 in a one-bedroom apartment and €150 to €216 in a two-bedroom apartment, depending on your dates. Accommodation runs from studios to three-bedroom apartments, which suits a group or family.

text: Which course to play from Four Seasons Vilamoura
**For the shortest trip,** Pinhal is next to the resort. Compare it with Laguna in [Vilamoura Laguna vs Pinhal](/guide/vilamoura-laguna-vs-pinhal-which-course-should-you-play).
**For the classic round,** the Old Course is about 8 minutes away. Read [Vila Sol vs the Old Course](/guide/vila-sol-vs-vilamoura-old-course-which-should-you-play).
**For value,** Laguna and Millennium start at €88, and Vila Sol's twilight rate is €60. See [the cheapest golf in Vilamoura](/guide/cheapest-golf-in-vilamoura).
Getting there

Four Seasons Vilamoura is about **35 minutes and 25 km from Faro Airport** by car, without traffic. See [Faro Airport to Vilamoura with golf clubs](/guide/faro-airport-to-vilamoura-with-golf-clubs) and [golf hotels near Vilamoura](/guide/golf-hotels-near-vilamoura).
Golf near Four Seasons Vilamoura: common questions
Which golf course is next to Four Seasons Vilamoura?
Vilamoura Pinhal. The resort overlooks the course, and its clubhouse is about 5 minutes away by car.
Is Four Seasons Vilamoura part of the Four Seasons hotel brand?
No. It's an independent apartment resort with a similar name.
Does Four Seasons Vilamoura sell golf packages?
Yes. Its golf co-ordinator arranges tee times, club hire and buggies, and the resort sells golf breaks with savings that depend on your apartment and dates.
Do I need a handicap to play near Four Seasons Vilamoura?
At the 18-hole courses, yes, usually up to 28 for men and 36 for ladies. See [do you need a handicap to play golf in the Algarve?](/guide/do-you-need-a-handicap-to-play-golf-in-the-algarve)
